apply: Per environment, with approval; nothing here has been applied.

1. Only after the switch: the Java services (worker and core included) stopped, core-scheduler and core-events running (the runbook, oci-config rust/RUNBOOK.md). Java core has no CoreServices.Platform.* and the worker would run every job a second time.
2. If the app is missing there: POST <env>/api/security/applications {"appCode": "platform", "appName": "Platform", "appType": "APP", "appAccessType": "OWN"} (security is not transported).
3. POST <env>/api/core/transports/createAndApply?isForBaseApp=true&applicationCode=platform multipart file=@platform_SYSTEM.cmodl (as app-transport.sh applies a core chunk; 30 objects, one request).
4. Verify: GET <env>/api/core/eventDefinitions?appCode=platform&clientCode=SYSTEM lists the 10 jobs with their schedules; the first ticks show in the event run log.
